definitions.low: Cheapest realistic nonstop window + mid-range hotel/condo (Expedia live or Dot-tier) + lean meals/ground/activities. Prefer Southwest Companion Pass “From” math when it beats cash-for-two; CP seats not held.
definitions.base: Same mid-range hotel band + fuller Dot-like other + reliable cash-for-two flight (or CP if that is the plan default).
definitions.high: Nicer ocean-view / resort (Wailea flagship on Maui; ~2× mid hotel on other islands — estimates labeled) + richer activities + peakish flights.

fcf_note.source: 2027 forecast FCF ≈ $5.4k after BBP payoff (income − normalized spend − BBP)
fcf_note.fit: One Low trip on any island fits comfortably inside ~$5.4k FCF. One Base trip fits on Maui/Oahu with room; Kona/Kauai Base is tight (~$5.2–5.4k). High / Wailea splurge does not fit in FCF alone.
